page.overview:
Who is Lenora?

Lenora is Gym Leader at Nacrene City's Nacrene City Gym in the Unova region. She is a -type leader. She rewards the player character with the Basic Badge if they defeat her. Lenora first appeared in Pokémon Black and White. Lenora goes to visit Sinnoh League Champion Cynthia in Undella Town. In Unova, Lenora is the second Gym Leader to be battled.

Lenora is a tall black woman with curly cyan hair and blue eyes. Lenora wears a striped headband, a white dress shirt with a white ribbon on her neck, as well as orange shoes, teal pants and a khaki apron with orange pockets. Lenora also wears a red lipstick.

Lenora is a very strong and capable middle-aged woman. She is the type to keep her word on things, judging by her relationship with her husband. Lenora prefers to be the assertive one between them. As seen by her study, she is quite organized and neat.

The name Lenora comes from "normal" and possibly "aloe", following her Japanese name.
